description:
Activate Rainveil Rejuvenator by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Rainveil Rejuvenator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Rainveil Rejuvenator
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater
